update.answer: LangGraph persistence saves the state of the graph or model so it can be resumed later. It ensures data integrity by retaining the program's configuration and parameters. This allows the system to continue operations without losing progress, even after restarts or crashes. The exact details of the persistence mechanism are not specified.
